exam_scheme.note: DSSSB recruits Nursing Officers through the One-Tier Technical (I-T-T) examination scheme comprising a single 2-hour CBT paper of 200 MCQs (200 marks). Section A tests general foundational aptitude (100 marks) and Section B tests domain professional nursing qualification (100 marks). Candidates must score at least 40% (UR/EWS), 35% (OBC Delhi), or 30% (SC/ST/PH) in Section B to qualify, with final selection based on total aggregate score.

financial_package.note: Nursing Officers in GNCTD hospitals are appointed under Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix at Level 7 (entry basic ₹44,900) and are entitled to specialized central health allowances including Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/month) and Uniform Allowance (₹1,800/month) in addition to Class 'X' metro allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: DSSSB Advt No. 04/2024 — Post Code 02/24 (Pay Level 7, ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 7 Entry Basic ₹44,900 + 58% DA (₹26,042) + 30% HRA (₹13,470) + TA (₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688) + Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/mo) + Uniform Allowance (₹1,800/mo) giving Gross ~₹99,100; In-Hand ~₹84,000–₹86,000 after 10% NPS (₹7,094), DGEHS, and income tax deductions.
official_perks: Nursing Allowance of ₹7,200 per month as sanctioned under 7th CPC recommendations
Uniform Allowance of ₹1,800 per month (₹21,600 per annum) for clinical hospital duties
Delhi Government Employees Health Scheme (DGEHS) comprehensive medical coverage across empanelled hospitals
Night Weightage Allowance and Special Duty Allowances for intensive care and emergency rotations
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly government matching contribution
Child Care Leave (CCL) up to 730 days for eligible female nursing personnel

competition_benchmarks.note: DSSSB Nursing Officer recruitments are high-volume healthcare selections across Delhi Government hospitals. Advt No. 04/2024 advertised 1,507 Nursing Officer vacancies (Post Code 02/24). In allied public health nursing examinations (Notice No. 303 dt 03-12-2025 for Post Code 30/24), 3,278 candidates appeared in CBT for 46 posts with 121 shortlisted for e-dossier, verified directly from official DSSSB marks notices.
